title: 港股'超级财报周'：小米(18日)、阿里/泡泡玛特/富途/快手/百度(20日前后)集体放榜，另美联储纪要与恒指季检同步来袭
summary: 本周为港股密集财报期，小米集团(1810.HK)定于8月18日公布Q2业绩；阿里巴巴(9988.HK)、泡泡玛特(9992.HK)、富途控股(FUTU)、快手、百度等将于8月20日前后集中披露半年报或季报。与此同时，美联储7月FOMC会议纪要将于本周发布，恒指季检结果亦同步出炉，市场波动率或因多重催化剂叠加而显著提升。
why: 多只持仓标的(小米/阿里/泡泡玛特/富途)本周密集披露业绩，叠加美联储纪要与恒指季检，事件驱动波动率显著上升

title: US-Iran Ceasefire MOU Expires; Trump Calls Talks 'Waste of Time'; Brent Crude Near $89 as Geopolitical Risk Spikes
summary: The US-Iran ceasefire memorandum of understanding expired on August 16 without renewal. President Trump described the negotiations as a waste of time. Brent crude oil prices rose to near $89/barrel as geopolitical risk premium in energy markets increased. US equity futures fell modestly in overnight trading as investors weighed the implications for global supply chains and inflation.
why: 中东地缘风险骤升推动原油价格上涨，直接影响通胀预期与美联储路径，对持仓的能源敏感板块构成波动催化剂

title: US July 2026 CPI +3.4% YoY (Core +2.5%); Energy +14.7%; Benign Print Lifts Asian Stocks, Below-50% Odds for Sep Fed Hike
summary: The US Bureau of Labor Statistics reported July 2026 CPI at +3.4% year-over-year (vs. +3.6% prior) and core CPI at +2.5% YoY (vs. +2.7% prior). Energy prices rose 14.7% YoY. The softer-than-expected print pushed federal funds futures to price in less than 50% probability of a September rate hike. Asian equities rallied on the news, with Hong Kong's Hang Seng rising and rate-sensitive sectors outperforming.
why: 美国7月CPI低于预期，9月加息概率降至50%以下，推动港股科技/消费板块估值修复，直接利好持仓的港股标的
source: US Bureau of Labor Statistics (官方)
why_still_developing: CPI数据发布于8月12日(距今5天)，市场对美联储9月决策的预期仍在持续演化，本周将有更多Fed官员讲话和纪要发布

title: S&P 500 Hits Record on Fed Pause Bets, But US Consumer Spending Drops Unexpectedly; Jobs Shock Adds to Caution
summary: The S&P 500 set a new intraday record on August 12 driven by bets that softer CPI would prompt the Federal Reserve to pause rate hikes. However, concurrent data showed unexpected declines in US consumer spending and a weaker-than-forecast jobs report, introducing caution. Analysts noted the divergence between equity optimism and underlying economic data weakness as a key risk into the week of August 17.
why: 美股创新高但消费数据走弱形成背离，影响对Costco/沃尔玛等消费持仓的基本面判断，本周零售财报将验证分歧
why_still_developing: 8月12日数据驱动行情的延伸效应将贯穿本周(8月17-21日)，与本周多项大盘催化剂叠加

title: US Super Earnings Week (Aug 17-21): Walmart, Target, Home Depot Report; Nvidia Q2 FY27 on Aug 26 (~$91-95B Revenue Expected)
summary: The week of August 17-21 is a major US earnings week. Key reports include Walmart (WMT, Aug 19), Target (TGT, Aug 20), and Home Depot (HD, Aug 19), which will provide crucial reads on US consumer health. Separately, Nvidia (NVDA) is scheduled to report Q2 FY2027 results on August 26, with analyst consensus expecting revenue of approximately $91-95 billion. Options markets are pricing elevated implied volatility for all these names.
why: 沃尔玛/Target/HD财报直接体现美国消费韧性；英伟达Q2将检验AI需求持续性，直接影响英伟达持仓估值与AI板块情绪
why_still_developing: 8月14日前瞻预告，事件本身(WMT/TGT/HD财报)发生在本周(8月17-21日)，属当期正在发酵事件

title: 贵州茅台H1 2026半年报：营收907亿元同比+1.47%，净利445亿元同比-1.95%，上市以来首现'增收不增利'
summary: 贵州茅台(600519.SH)披露2026年上半年业绩：实现营业收入907亿元，同比增长1.47%；归母净利润445亿元，同比下降1.95%，为公司上市以来首次出现营收正增长但净利润负增长的局面。市场分析认为，渠道库存压力上升、直销占比下降及营销费用增加是主因。茅台股价短期承压，白酒板块情绪转弱。
why: A股权重白酒龙头首现增收不增利，对白酒板块情绪有传导效应；亦作为消费行业基本面温度计供参考
why_still_developing: 8月14日业绩披露，机构研报与分析师调整仍在持续，白酒板块影响延伸至本周

title: Tesla (TSLA) Wins 1,021-Day Swedish Strike: IF Metall Ends Action After Tesla Buys Out All Striking Workers
summary: Swedish labor union IF Metall called off its 1,021-day strike against Tesla on August 13, 2026, after Tesla reached a settlement that included buying out contracts for all remaining striking workers. Tesla has maintained its position of not signing collective bargaining agreements in Sweden. The resolution removes a lingering European labor overhang for Tesla and may influence the company's broader European expansion strategy.
why: 特斯拉欧洲最长劳工纠纷正式终结，消除欧洲扩张不确定性，对TSLA持仓的欧洲市场估值有边际正向影响
why_still_developing: 8月13日结案新闻，欧洲劳工关系与特斯拉欧洲战略影响仍在发酵期内
